scope: One additional exploratory observer case selected by an existing free-model physical column reference, without inspecting its observer residuals.
quantity: Radial n=2 column from 1.725 to 3 planetary radii within the existing model domain, cm^-2
selection_metric: Absolute natural logarithm of candidate column divided by the free-model target column
rule: After both D12 and D15 are accepted and independently CPU verified, choose the single factor with the smaller metric, only if it is nearer than D10. Break an exact tie by the lower factor. Otherwise add no observer case.
qualification: Use structure.json for columns, verify its physical-state input hash, and separately require the independent CPU receipt to pass for the same exported state. The immutable GPU summary pending flag is not a CPU status indicator.
priority: Primary D10 and D20 observer comparisons retain priority. No new atmosphere solve is requested. Perform the selected observer calculation while D20 solves if feasible.
interpretation: Nearest tested column is not exact column matching, opacity-profile matching, or an independently fitted physical model. This case is exploratory and is not selected by Q or residual improvement.
